taxpayer_name.rationale: No canonical element for taxpayer name exists in this candidate list; the form header name field is not represented in the IRS4562 XSD elements provided.

taxpayer_identifying_number.rationale: No canonical element for taxpayer identifying number (SSN/EIN) exists in this candidate list; the form header EIN/SSN field is not represented in the IRS4562 XSD elements provided.

business_activity.rationale: BusinessOrActivityTxt directly matches the 'Business or activity to which this form relates' header field described in the blueprint.

line_1_section_179_max_deduction.rationale: MaximumDollarLimitationAmt corresponds to Part I Line 1, the maximum Section 179 dollar limit for the tax year.

line_2_total_cost_section_179_property.rationale: TotalCostOfSection179PropAmt corresponds to Part I Line 2, total cost of Section 179 property placed in service.

line_3_threshold_cost.rationale: ThresholdCostOfSect179PropAmt corresponds to Part I Line 3, the threshold cost above which the phase-out begins.

line_4_reduction_in_limitation.rationale: ReductionInLimitationAmt corresponds to Part I Line 4, the reduction in the dollar limitation.

line_5_dollar_limitation.rationale: DollarLimitationForTaxYearAmt corresponds to Part I Line 5, the dollar limitation for the tax year after reduction.

line_6_section_179_properties.rationale: ElectedProperty is the repeating group element for Line 6 property rows; blueprint models this as an array but the canonical schema splits it into ElectedProperty (group) with child elements PropertyDesc, CostForBusinessUseOnlyAmt, ElectedCostAmt — blueprint should decompose each array row into those three leaf fields.

line_7_listed_property_elected_cost.rationale: TotalSection179ExpenseAmt does not match; the best match for Line 7 listed property elected cost from Part V Line 29 is TotalListedDepreciationAmt — however that is line 28 total. Actually, no single candidate cleanly maps to 'listed property elected cost from Part V line 29'; null is safer.

line_8_total_elected_cost.rationale: TotalElectedCostSect179PropAmt corresponds to Part I Line 8, the total elected cost of Section 179 property.

line_9_tentative_deduction.rationale: TentativeDeductionAmt corresponds to Part I Line 9, the tentative Section 179 deduction.

line_10_carryover_from_prior_year.rationale: DisallowedDeductionCyovAmt corresponds to Part I Line 10, the carryover of disallowed Section 179 deduction from the prior year.

line_11_business_income_limitation.rationale: BusinessIncomeLimitationAmt corresponds to Part I Line 11, the business income limitation on the Section 179 deduction.

line_12_section_179_deduction.rationale: Section179ExpenseDeductionAmt corresponds to Part I Line 12, the current-year Section 179 expense deduction.

line_13_carryover_to_next_year.rationale: NextYearCarryoverAmt corresponds to Part I Line 13, the carryover of disallowed Section 179 deduction to the next year.
